# MarketForge Video Scripts

Apply V3 §3.6 (YouTube), §3.7 (TikTok), §4.2 (Meta video), `ai-saturation-watch.md` Cycle 5.

## Global quality rules

- 9:16 vertical priority for paid + organic short-form.
- Hook in first 1-3 seconds.
- Captions burned in (most muted).
- Sub-30-second sequence priority for cold prospecting.
- Founder / employee / real-customer voice > AI narration.

## Purpose

1. UGC creator briefs (for influencer / customer-style).
2. Founder explainer scripts.
3. Demo scripts (screen recording + voiceover).
4. Ad scripts (paid social video).
5. YouTube long-form briefs.

## Inputs
- `ad-creative-brief.md`, `paid-social.md`, `youtube-strategy.md`, `tiktok-organic.md`, `founder-content.md`.
- `messaging-architecture.md`, `voice-of-customer.md`.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/10-visual-assets/video-scripts/[category]/[asset-id].md`
- DEC-730 to DEC-735

## Per-script template

```markdown
# Video Script: [Asset ID]

## Context
- Channel: [TikTok / Meta Reels / YouTube / LinkedIn / etc.]
- Format: 9:16 vertical / 16:9 horizontal / 1:1 square
- Length: [15s / 30s / 60s / longer]
- Awareness stage: [from awareness-stages.md]

## Hook (0:00-0:03)

### Visual
[What's on screen at 0:00 — specific]

### Audio
[What's said / sound at 0:00]

### Captions (on-screen text)
[First line that appears]

## Body (0:03 to N-3 sec)

### Visual cuts
- 0:03: [shot]
- 0:08: [shot]
- 0:15: [shot]

### Voice / narration
[Word-by-word; conversational; specific numbers]

### B-roll if applicable
[Product screenshots, screen recordings]

## CTA (last 3 sec)

### Visual
[Final shot]

### Audio
[CTA]

### Captions
[CTA text]

### Click-target on-screen
[Where viewer clicks / swipes]

## Production type
- UGC creator (brief follows)
- Founder-recorded (script follows)
- Studio-produced
- AI voice + B-roll (rarely; risk of saturation)
- Screen recording + voiceover

## Music / sound
- Trend-jack sound (TikTok): [specific trending sound; replaceable as trend dies]
- Custom audio: [brief]
- No music (talking-head): captions decisive

## Anti-patterns avoided
- Generic "[Brand] helps you [taste-word]" opener.
- Slow start (no hook in first 3 sec).
- Voiceover-over-stock-video aesthetic.
- AI-narrated full piece (detected).

## Decision cards
[DEC-730+]
```

## When to delegate
- `marketing-skills:video` for additional script-writing support.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- AI-narrated voiceover when founder/employee voice available.
- Slow openers without hook.
- Generic UGC briefs without creator-style direction.

## Sources and basis
V3 §3.6, §3.7, §4.2.
